sources.finding: AWS maintains the Ethereum v1.0/eth path in public bucket aws-public-blockchain, us-east-2; anonymous access is documented.
Ethereum blocks, transactions and logs are date-partitioned Parquet tables; the documented dataset is experimental.

Schema lists raw log address/topics/data and position/hash/time fields, transaction receipt_status, and parent-linked block identifiers. Actual object schema still requires a footer check. Decoded token-transfer values are documented as double, so exact event amounts should be decoded from raw bytes.

Current Ethereum dataset route is bigquery-public-data.goog_blockchain_ethereum_mainnet_us with logs, receipts, transactions and blocks; addresses are lowercase. Dataset tables use monthly block_timestamp partitions. No BigQuery query was attempted; actual schemas/access/cost remain unverified in this session.
ethereum.raw.logs exposes raw topics separately as topic0..3, data, emitter and block/transaction/log positions; normalization must preserve absent topics correctly.
ethereum.raw.transactions documents receipt_status as1success/0failure and transaction/block identity fields. No Allium query/access or export was attempted.
